dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you usually handle the issue?

dialogues.speaker: Yarovaya
dialogues.text: We organize search groups, and if they detect the Shadow Realm's energy core, they neutralize it. If not, they'll seal it off.

dialogues.speaker: Yarovaya
dialogues.text: Most Shadow Realms disappear naturally over time... so there's no great disaster, so long as no one enters them by mistake.
